svg.title: Anatomy of a research paper

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each part answers one question. Most readers stop early, so each part must stand on its own.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What is this paper about? Name the objects and the type of result.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What does it prove or find? All main contributions, strong verbs, no

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Why it matters, what was missing, what is new. Main results stated early.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Only the definitions and known results the paper uses, with one notation.

svg.text: How the results are obtained. Each section opens with its goal.
